item.title: Minimum Hybrid Kontrakt (MHK): En kombinasjon av Juridiske og Blockchain-baserte Smarte Kontrakter
item.about: Jørgen Svennevik Notland's master's thesis on the Minimum Hybrid Contract (MHC): a legal contract combined with a blockchain smart contract for transparent, immutable financial transactions. Supervisors named on the NTNU Open record are Røger Sørheim and Donn Morrison. The NTNU Open degree-type field says bachelor.
item.title_en: The Minimum Hybrid Contract (MHC): Combining Legal and Blockchain Smart Contracts
